blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-accordion-root: Marks the root for the JS keyboard-navigation module; React uses a context ref.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-active: JS-side active-item tracking; React holds this in component state.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-composite-item: Composite navigation registration; React uses a ref registry.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-disable-scrollbar: Scroll-lock coordination between .NET and the JS module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-focus-guard-type: Distinguishes guard direction for the JS focus manager.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-label: Carries the item label to JS for typeahead; React passes it in props.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-list-item: List registration for the JS navigation module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-navigation-menu-view: Viewport morph target lookup for the JS module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-popover-arrow: Arrow element lookup for the JS positioner.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-positioner: Positioner element lookup for the JS floating module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-base-ui-toast-root: Toast registration for the JS timer module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-otp-hidden-input: Hidden input lookup for the JS OTP module.
blazorOnly.data-blazix-otp-input: Slot input lookup for the JS OTP module.
